design_system.note: Tokens are proposed. Replace with Quest-August-2026-service-report.html when the file is located. Do not restyle the sample to match these tokens.

purpose.objective: One Quest-layout monthly service report a buyer can read in one sitting and Bruce can approve without rebuilding numbers.
purpose.job: Show volume, SLA, and up to three decisions for a closed calendar month.

audience.primary: Quest economic buyer reading a PDF or HTML file
audience.secondary: Bruce Penson reviewing the draft before send
audience.context: Email or meeting walkthrough. Not an in-app screen.

do: Lead with counts and percents, then a short explanation
Use card labels Done, In effect, and Next
Omit a date when Meeting Tracker has none
dont: Print ticket IDs, end-user names, or a raw title dump
Encode SLA with colour and no percent
Fill a quiet month with praise

components.name: Report/Header
components.content_guidelines: Pro Drive wordmark treatment from the Quest sample. Client-facing account name.

components.name: Report/MetricTile
components.content_guidelines: Value is copied from facts.json. Percent variant always prints the number.

components.name: Report/Section
components.content_guidelines: Semantic heading. Empty wider-base is one plain sentence.

components.name: Report/InsightCard
components.content_guidelines: Maximum 3 cards. Drafter must not add a fourth.

components.name: Report/Footer
components.content_guidelines: Issued date from facts. Confidential line only if the Quest sample has one.

branding.status: use Quest sample; do not invent a new system

prototype.status: file not located in the automation repo on 2026-09-28

deliverables: Single HTML template matching the Quest sample
PDF export for the client send

a11y.min_touch_applies_to: future HTML controls only; not this PDF

naming.template: one Quest layout for every client

metrics.primary: Named Quest buyer states 2 non-break-fix items from the report
metrics.secondary: Bruce review at or under 15 minutes with 0 tile corrections
metrics.success_criteria: Do not redesign. The Quest sample is the control.
